auth: Google-login bearer (require_google_user). Read only: no agent run, no mail, no DB write.
owner_scope: work_cases, quote_versions and suppliers are filtered by the caller's owner_user_id. A missing or another user's case returns the same 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.
source: work_cases.latest_review_jsonb written by DB commit_reply_review after review_card_check (migration kan172), work_cases.review_revision, input_revision, status, decision, selected_plan_id, selected_plan_jsonb, selected_at, archived_at, accepted_at.
response: case_id, review_revision, input_revision (card's), is_stale, created_at (not stored by the DB: null), source_quote_ids[]
review_outcome: COMPLETED / REVIEW_REQUIRED_CLOSED / NO_VALID_PLAN (stored value as is), closure_reason (string for REVIEW_REQUIRED_CLOSED, else null)

plans[]{plan_id (null on a card without one: not selectable), plan_type, validation_status, total_amount, currency, allocations[]{supplier_id, supplier_name, quote_id, quantity, unit, unit_price}, conditions[], adjustments[], reason}

counter_offer{status, reason, target{supplier_id, supplier_name, target_unit_price, conditions[]} or null, reference{status, unit, requested_unit_price, previous_unit_price, ceiling_unit_price, alternative_total, allowed_range[]} or null, draft_ids[]} or null
questions[]{supplier_id, supplier_name, field, priority, reason, break_even_amount, formula}
unresolved[], decision{decision, plan_id, note, decided_at} or null, allowed_actions[], disabled_actions[]{action, reason_code, message}
numbers: Amounts, quantities and unit prices are Decimal strings without trailing zeros or exponent.
stored_shape_compatibility: Allocations hold supplier_id, quote_version_id and quantity only, so supplier_name comes from suppliers and unit/unit_price from the referenced quote. A stored supplier_name/unit/unit_price is kept as is.

actions.closed: archived, accepted, or decision CONFIRM_REVIEW/ACCEPT_INCREASE: allowed [] and disabled [].
actions.stale: All of SELECT_PLAN, HOLD, CONFIRM_REVIEW disabled with REVIEW_STALE.
actions.not_complete: Case status other than Complete (review running, or a counter-offer draft still waiting: the card is not committed yet so the API returns REVIEW_NOT_READY): all disabled with REVIEW_NOT_CURRENT.
actions.complete: SELECT_PLAN when at least one VALID plan with a plan_id (else disabled NO_SELECTABLE_PLAN); HOLD unless the decision is already HOLD; CONFIRM_REVIEW.
actions.pending_agreement: Default rules follow the frontend preview; confirm with frontend. Saving decisions is API-15 (separate ticket).
actions.not_ready: API-15 change functions (lookup_work_case_change_request, submit_work_case_change) not deployed: all of SELECT_PLAN, HOLD, CONFIRM_REVIEW disabled with CASE_CHANGE_INTEGRATION_REQUIRED (same check as the list and detail views).

decision: decision from work_cases.decision; plan_id from selected_plan_id; note from selected_plan_jsonb.note; decided_at from selected_at (null for HOLD/CONFIRM until API-15 defines its storage).

errors.RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND: 404: case missing or outside the owner scope
errors.REVIEW_NOT_READY: 404: the case has no stored card
errors.PROCESSING_UNAVAILABLE: 503: storage unavailable or the stored card shape is invalid (including a review_outcome the DB does not store)

decisions_2026_11_06.review_outcome: Return the DB value unchanged. The DB derives it: REVIEW_REQUIRED_CLOSED when the counter-offer is HOLD or any plan is CONDITIONAL (closure_reason required), else COMPLETED. The frontend already shows both codes; Notion 08 is to follow the 06 closure codes.
decisions_2026_11_06.cards_without_plans: Not stored: review_card_check needs 1-5 plans. A role 3/4 HOLD ends the review as Pending/ON_HOLD without a card.
decisions_2026_11_06.plan_id: Set by the RESPONSE_PLAN final check (P1, P2, ...). API-15 SELECT_PLAN finds the plan by this ID in that run output, so it is never invented at read time.
decisions_2026_11_06.question_priority: Agent values MUST_CONFIRM / CAN_CHANGE_CHOICE / LOW_VALUE are passed through; the frontend maps labels.
